svg.title: Antinodes of the 12 by 12 example for both parts
svg.desc: Antennas with the same frequency (0 or A) form pairs. In part 1 each pair creates two antinodes, one beyond each antenna at the same distance, 14 inside the map. In part 2 every cell reached by repeatedly stepping by the pair offset counts, 34 in total.

g.text: green: antennas 0 · blue: antennas A · #: antinode inside the map
Part 1 · one antinode beyond each antenna
14 antinodes · 2a − b and 2b − a for every pair
dashed: the pair of A antennas at (6,5) and (8,8)
Part 2 · every grid step along the line
step by (dx, dy) from each antenna until off the map
